# LBFGS++ vendoring information

Upstream: https://github.com/yixuan/LBFGSpp

Revision: `1695839b5c4c3448ca13680ff954d7606c7e3d0f`

Snapshot date: 2026-08-02

BRL-CAD vendors the upstream documentation, license, author list, and public
headers needed by the header-only unconstrained L-BFGS solver.  LBFGS++ states
that it was adapted from the MIT-licensed libLBFGS project and is itself
distributed under the MIT license.  No code from Geogram's separately bundled
HLBFGS implementation is included or used.
